name: golpo
description: Generate AI videos with Golpo from prompts, scripts, audio, or documents. Auto-downloads the rendered MP4 to ~/Golpo/videos/.

interface.shortDescription: Turn prompts, scripts, audio, or documents into AI videos.
interface.longDescription: Golpo turns a prompt, custom script, audio narration, or supporting documents (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/TXT) into a finished animated video. Codex picks sensible defaults (30s, 16:9, Sketch Classic, English) so most requests need no follow-up. The skill polls until the job is done, then auto-downloads the MP4 to ~/Golpo/videos/ and prints the hosted URL.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second video about why the sky is blue.
Summarize this PDF as a 1-minute vertical short.
Turn my narration audio into an animated explainer.
